## Scope and approval

What changes? Link the scoped maintainer approval for any protected workflow.

## Evidence

- [ ] Exact dependency pin retained, or reviewed dependency change explained
- [ ] Build and unit tests run; commands/results/failures listed below
- [ ] Synthetic data only; source, images and commit metadata reviewed
- [ ] Upstream attribution and notices retained
- [ ] Authorization, units, command ordering, retries and recovery unchanged, or explicitly approved
- [ ] Bench validation listed separately from emulator/unit evidence

## Limitations and rollback

What remains untested? How can this change be reverted without losing user data?

Do not attach raw logs, pairing codes, identifiers, private screenshots or health histories.
